[L3] When one service's p99 spikes but its own rps/CPU/conns are flat, the cause is almost always shared infrastructure (postgres/redis) contention or a batch job, not the service. Query the backend's CPU/latency for the same minutes early. Confirmed p-001, p-002. Active.
[L4] Scan deploys AND config_changes for 24h, not 2h. cost-optimizer-bot cuts land hours before biting at the next peak (day2 cfg-002 search replicas 6->5; day4 cfg-004 payments db_pool_max 50->20 at 02:00, paged 11:36). Suspect bot cuts when a page hits a peak. Note late unpaged changes at handoff, but drop them after ~2 quiet days (day4-5 deploys + cfg-006 aged out clean). Active.
[L5] Never rule out a deploy by its commit message. Day2 "clean up dead code" (search), "fix typo in order email template" (inventory), "refactor handler" (checkout) were all in live paths. Messages recycle across days AND across services on the same day (day9: dep-019 inventory + dep-020 payments both "fix typo in order email template"). Correlate by ts vs metric breakpoint instead. Active.
[L6] Fast path when a page matches a known noise entry: issue 2 queries in ONE batch (no dependency) — (1) metrics by minute for the alerting service AND its backend over the window (expect flat rps/errors/conns/CPU + p99 spike), (2) logs incl. level='INFO' grouped by service+minute for the batch-job line. The deepest service's first WARN minute is the true onset; alerts lag it ~20min. Date deploys/configs against that onset (ruled out dep-008 in p-005). Confirmed p-005. Active.
[L9] cost-optimizer-bot cuts land ~02:00, intermittent, sometimes reverted. Day4 cfg-004 payments db_pool_max 50->20 -> p-005 (reverted cfg-005). Day7 checkout.worker_threads 16->12. Day9 web.cache_ttl_s 60->45. Day10 redis.maxmemory_mb 4096->3584. Any resource knob (pool, threads, replicas, TTL, memory) counts. Query config_changes 24h+ for a fresh cut AND any revert before blaming a deploy. Active.

Watching from day10, still unpaged through day11 03:02 (only N2 reindex since): cfg-010 02:00 redis.maxmemory_mb 4096->3584 (bot; expect eviction -> hit-rate drop -> search p99 at peak), dep-022 12:20 web v3.12.5, dep-023 12:25 search v1.9.4 "bump dependencies".
